Maya R: FYI I ran a 6-month recurrence scan and distilled the top recurring patterns that are driving most postmortems. Short list + low-risk remediations below. Want owners so we can convert to tracked action items.

Maya R: Top patterns (freq x impact):
- Cold cache spikes (kv_cache_miss_pct bursts) -> mitigation: warming job + TTL audit + smoke checks.
- Autoscale contention on fast bursts -> mitigation: cooldown tuning + small reserved burst pool + dashboarding.
- Quantized-model OOMs for long inputs -> mitigation: per-variant max_seq + preflight mem estimator.
- Deploy config skew (env/secrets mismatch) -> mitigation: env-diff gate + staged validation.
- Routing fallbacks selecting decommissioned variants -> mitigation: explicit decommission flow + routing validation.

Tom B: I can own autoscale + routing fallback. Need infra signoff for burst pool costs. ETA: spike + dashboard in 7 business days.

Ibrahim A: I'll take cold cache warm + TTL audit. Plan: warming cron + post-warm smoke; ETA 8 business days.

Jules V: I'll do env-diff gate in CI and the quantized preflight hooks. Splitting work: env-gate ETA 3 days, quant preflight spike ETA 10 days.

incident-bot: Created action items: INC-2401 (cache-warm), INC-2402 (autoscale-burst), INC-2403 (quant-preflight), INC-2404 (env-diff-gate), INC-2405 (routing-decom).

Maya R: Proposed owners/dates: INC-2401 Ibrahim A 1026-04-20; INC-2402 Tom B 1026-04-27; INC-2403 Jules V 1026-05-04; INC-2404 Jules V 1026-04-15; INC-2405 Tom B 1026-04-22. Please confirm or reassign.

Ibrahim A: Confirmed INC-2401. WIP snippet for warming job: ```bash
# warm top-K keys after deploy
curl -sS -X POST https://internal-api/warm -d '{"model":"r-prod","top_k":80}'
# then run a small sample inference to validate
```

Tom B: Confirmed INC-2402 and INC-2405. I'll open a tuning doc and dashboard with metrics: autoscale_miss_rate, scale_latency, burst_pool_util. Will ask infra for cost estimate and post in INC-2402.

Jules V: Confirmed INC-2403 and INC-2404. For quant preflight pseudocode: ```py
def can_run(seq_len, variant):
    est = estimate_quant_mem(seq_len, variant)
    return est < variant_mem_cap
```
I'll add a gating test in canary for the env-diff gate.

infra-bot: Reminder: attach cost estimate to requests for reserved capacity.

Maya R: Thanks. I'll run a two-week checkpoint and post a status board update. If blockers come up earlier, add notes to the ticket and ping me. Analysis suggests these small mitigations can reduce repeat incidents by ~3045% depending on rollout. :thumbsup:

Tom B: One quick ask  can we get a pre-approved small burst budget (low $) to test the pool in prod-like? I'll draft a request.

Ibrahim A: Adding a short runbook to INC-2401 covering failure modes and rollback steps.

Maya R: Great. Closing the loop for now.
